description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to understand the 3-stage pipeline and the vault path convention. 2. Agent runs `python3 scripts/gather_week.py --memory-dir /workspace/memory/game-dev --days 7 --end-date 2024-03-17` to gather the sprint week logs. 3. Agent pipes that JSON output into `python3 scripts/analyze.py` to detect patterns, accomplishments (shipped/fixed/built items), recurring themes (audio, pathfinding, physics), and friction points (audio license blocker). 4. Agent pipes the analysis JSON into `python3 scripts/retrospective.py --output vault/weekly-retro/2024-03-17.md` — critically, WITHOUT --no-frontmatter, so the YAML frontmatter (date_range, week_score, tags) is included. 5. Agent saves the analysis JSON to a temp file and runs `python3 scripts/history.py --record --analysis <path>` OR pipes analysis into `history.py --record` to persist the longitudinal record at vault/retro-history/history.json. The proprietary traps: (a) correct vault path structure YYYY-MM-DD.md, (b) must NOT use --no-frontmatter, (c) must use --end-date 2024-03-17 not today's date, (d) must point to the specific game-dev subdirectory not the memory root, (e) must run history.py separately to record the entry.
